utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo said we’re meeting next Thursday at Mara’s place. And if Rey wants, Tess can swing by too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — and Hana can confirm the next title. I’m pretty sure it’s a mystery with a good twist.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, and Rey can borrow your copy when it comes in. I’ll remind folks to bring a snack if they can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — Rosa’s ideas will be great, and Jules has snacks and a question covered too. I can swing by if Rey wants, and then we can compare notes after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — I’ll bring a couple of ideas, and if you need me to help host next time, I’m happy to. Thursday at the cafe still works for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thursday at the cafe works for me — thanks, Rosa. I’ll bring my notes and we can compare after the first meeting.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I picked *The Night Circus* for this month, and I’m still waiting on the book and the time. Noah said he’d keep an eye out by the door for the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring a snack if I can. And if Nell makes it, maybe she can bring one too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be lovely, thank you. I’ll let Rosa know we’re still sorting the next pick too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to wait until Kira confirms the time and place before I commit. Once that’s set, I can let you know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — once Kira confirms, just let me know and I’ll keep my snacks and question ready for Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — I’ll wait for Kira’s confirmation and then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thursday at 7 at the community center, right? I’ll borrow *The Midnight Library* and catch up before then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, Thursday at 7 at the community center. I’ll let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Mina — I’ll grab The Midnight Library and see you Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — Leo can send over the date that works best, Cleo’s bringing tea and snacks, and Quinn can send everyone the details and a quick invite. Eli’s in too, so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I’ll bring cookies to the book club at the community center. Mara’s hosting, so I’ll see everyone there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, cookies sound great — thanks, Oren. I’ll see everyone at the community center when Mara hosts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me, and I’ll come with the book ready. I’ll wait for Quinn’s details and then head over.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Thursday at 7 sounds good. I’m just waiting on the book and the final details, then I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — once Quinn sends the details, I’ll head over Thursday at 7 with the book ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check the book club title first, and then I’ll confirm it for you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — just let me know the title, and I’ll send Bo the book and time after errands.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m checking it now, and I’ll confirm the exact book club title shortly.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think Ira sent Bo the book and the time, and Rosa’s checking the library copy on Maple Street. If you need the details, Sam can help too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — I’m in for the book club meeting. Just send me Quinn’s invite when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll send Quinn’s invite as soon as it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thursday at your place works for me. Thanks for sending the details and invite soon.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — I’ll send the details and a quick invite to everyone soon. See you Thursday at my place!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — see you Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thursday works for the book club — I’ll ask what everyone thinks and let Ira know. Also, please bring your pick if you can, and I’ll check who wants to host next time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m looking forward to it, and I’ll bring my pick if I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll follow up with anyone who hasn’t replied yet and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — Uli said they’d share the book club details with me. I’ll keep an eye out by the door, and Cleo’s tea and snacks are a nice touch.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So we’re still on Thursday, right? And are we all reading the same book this week?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, Thursday still sounds right to me — and I think we’re all doing "The Midnight Library". Dane was going to borrow Gus’s spare copy and catch up before then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring tea and some snacks to book club.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s kind of you, Cleo — tea would be great for Thursday. Quinn is sending the details soon, and I’m looking forward to it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll bring the tea and a few snacks for Thursday then.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’ll bring a couple easy snacks and a discussion question for the club.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nice, that works for me. I’m still waiting on the book and time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Opal’s got the meeting spot covered, and Mina’s letting everyone know it’s Thursday. Vik is checking in with anyone who hasn’t replied yet, so we should have the rest soon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I picked The Night Circus for this month, and I can drop the book club details by Noah’s door. Rosa’s helping choose the next one, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s right — I’ll bring a couple of ideas for the next pick. And I can help host next time if needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be lovely, thank you. I’ll leave the details by Noah’s door soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks—please send the invite when you can. I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s date and Cleo’s tea and snacks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll send everyone the details and a quick invite for Thursday’s book club at my place.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Thursday works for me—thanks for taking care of the invite.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thursday at Quinn’s place works if the invite goes out soon, and I’m happy to wait for Kira’s confirmation on the time and place before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m double-checking the book club title first, then I’ll confirm it so Kira can pass along the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that works for me — just let me know once the title’s confirmed and Kira has the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Cleo said the group decided to meet next Thursday at Mara’s place. And Rey can borrow Gus’s copy when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hmm, I’ve still got it as Thursday at the community center, and I’ll send Bo the book and time after I’m done errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I must’ve missed that update—sounds like we should double-check which Thursday spot is right. I’ll wait on the latest word before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll bring the cookies to the community center for book club. Mara’s hosting, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, Mara’s hosting. Jules is bringing a couple easy snacks and a discussion question, and Rosa has a couple ideas too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, that’s at the community center. I’ll still bring the cookies and make sure I’m there for Mara’s book club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa’s helping pick the next book, and Sam can help with the details. I’m organizing things, and Oren’s bringing the cookies.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, sounds like it’s coming together. Eli and Mina are in, and Nell may bring a snack if she can make it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wonderful — that should make for a nice turnout. I’ll keep coordinating the details and let Rosa know the book pick is still in progress.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll ask what everyone thinks, tell Ira what they said, and remind folks to bring their pick for Thursday. I’ll also check who wants to host next time and follow up with anyone who hasn’t replied yet.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, and if you need the details side, Sam can help with that. Oren has the cookies, Mara is on setup, and Jules is handling snacks plus a discussion question.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll keep Thursday in mind and loop everyone in on the details. I’ll ask what they think and make sure Ira hears back.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m looking forward to it—Mina, let me know the meeting details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: It’s still Thursday, right? I just want to confirm we’re all on the same book this week.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I believe we’re still on Thursday—Mina was checking the meeting details, so I’m just waiting on the final confirmation too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday at 7 works for me—I’ll be there with the book ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, see you Thursday at 7. I’ve got a spare copy of The Midnight Library for Dane, and Rey can borrow mine when it comes in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Gus—Thursday at 7 it is. I’ll bring my copy and see everyone then.
